About me

The word DJ makes you think of a bad haircut, too much jewellery and attitude. DJ Rawlo has all the right approaches towards music, but not the rest.

I'm looking for events that need an energetic host to keep a birthday, wedding or corporate night non-stop fun and memorable for everyone.
